about.title: About Collage Studio
about.intro: Collage Studio is a free photo collage maker that runs entirely in your web browser. Add your photos, pick a layout, style it and export a high-resolution image. There is no sign-up, no watermark and no upload: your photos never leave your device.
faq.a1: Yes. Collage Studio is free to use, with no account, no watermark and no limit on the number of collages you can make.
faq.a2: No. All editing and exporting happens locally in your browser. Your photos are never sent to a server, and there is no tracking or data collection.
faq.q3: How do I make a photo collage?
faq.a3: Add several photos with the Add photos button or by dragging them onto the page. Auto-fit picks the layout that crops your photos the least. Then adjust spacing, colors, filters, text and stickers, and press Export.
faq.q4: Which formats and sizes can I export?
faq.a4: You can export PNG, JPG, WebP and PDF at up to four times the canvas size, with presets for Instagram, Stories, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook and print sizes, or your own custom size.
faq.q5: Does it work offline and on my phone?
faq.a5: Yes. Collage Studio works on phones, tablets and desktops, and it can be installed as an app that keeps working without an internet connection.
faq.q6: Can I keep working on a collage later?
faq.a6: Your last session is restored automatically on the same device. You can also save a project file and open it again whenever you like.
